issues: React console warning: 'Received true for a non-boolean attribute textarea'. The <Field textarea> prop is being spread onto the <textarea> DOM element. Filter the `textarea` prop out of ...props before spreading. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) In Contact.jsx Field component, destructure `textarea` out of props before spreading onto the DOM textarea to silence a React attribute warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo but the Pydantic model types it as datetime — inconsistency between in-memory model and persisted doc; acceptable since not re-read but worth aligning.

Contact endpoint returns 500/502 on email failure after already inserting the DB row — user sees error yet message was persisted. Consider returning 200 with a warning, or wrapping DB insert in the same try/except, so behavior is transactional.
Field label whitespace/casing 'M E S S A G E' comes from tracking CSS, not a bug.
